businessLogic.cleanSource:
Form.HeaderRawHTML += '<link href="../reporteserp/css/kendo.common.min.css" rel="stylesheet" id="common-css" />'
	Form.HeaderRawHTML += '<link href="../reporteserp/css/kendo.blueopal.min.css" rel="stylesheet" id="skin-css" />'
	Form.HeaderRawHTML += '<script src="../reporteserp/Scripts/themeSwitcher.js"></script>'
	Form.HeaderRawHTML += '<script src="../reporteserp/api/reports/resources/js/telerikReportViewer"></script>'
	&NumFila = ObtenerConfiguracion.Udp(!'FilasLoteReporte').ToNumeric()
	If Not &NumFila > 0 And &NumFila < 13
		msg('Es necesario configurar las filas para el reporte, este valor debe estar entre 1 y 12')
	Else
		
		LlenarLoteReporte.Call(&EmbarqueId, &NumFila)
		Commit
		
		Do Case
			Case &enumFormatoEmbarque = EnumFormatoEmbarque.CertificadoCalidad
				&SDTTelerik.ReportName = !'CertificadoCalidad'
			Case &enumFormatoEmbarque = EnumFormatoEmbarque.ValeSalida
				&SDTTelerik.ReportName = !'ValeSalida'
		EndCase
	
		&SDTInformeFilter.Id = &EmbarqueId
		&SDTInformeFilter.Fila = &NumFila
		
		CODEWC.Caption = InformesTelerik.Udp(&SDTTelerik, &SDTInformeFilter)
		
	EndIf
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	TblReport.Height = 1000
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */
